rationale: The round-3 discourse has clarified the economic test and narrowed the debate to plant-by-plant viability, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour/state insist on no closures or compulsory redundancies, while management/investors insist those remain available. Positions have hardened into a stable impasse, so further open-ended rounds are likely to circle unless an external audit/intervention reframes the decision on verified numbers.
